<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=How Do You Spell ‘Beige?’|id=A0019}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
You have a question? Liliana and JP tell us how to ask it. Specifically, they talk about a spelling question; thus, the keyword is '''be de burro''' – b as in donkey (b as in Bob).
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0005|A0005: Take a picture]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0008|A0008: How do you say ...?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0011|A0011: Call me]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Tengo una pregunta.'''
| I have a question.
| '''¡Dime!'''
| Tell me!
| '''¿Cómo se escribe beige?'''
| How do you write beige?
| '''¿El color? Se escribe con be de burro, e, i, ge, e.'''
| The color? You write it with b as in Bob, e, i, g, e.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thanks.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Tengo una pregunta.'''
| I have a question.
| '''¡Dime!'''
| Tell me!
| '''¿Cómo se escribe beige?'''
| How do you write beige?
| '''¿El color? Se escribe con be de burro, e, i, ge, e.'''
| The color? You write it with b as in Bob, e, i, g, e.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thanks.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| I have a question.
| '''Tengo una pregunta.'''
| Tell me!
| '''¡Dime!'''
| How do you write beige?
| '''¿Cómo se escribe beige?'''
| The color? You write it with b as in Bob, e, i, g, e.
| '''¿El color? Se escribe con be de burro, e, i, ge, e.'''
| Thanks.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| I have a question.
| '''Tengo una pregunta.'''
| Tell me!
| '''¡Dime!'''
| How do you write beige?
| '''¿Cómo se escribe beige?'''
| The color? You write it with b as in Bob, e, i, g, e.
| '''¿El color? Se escribe con be de burro, e, i, ge, e.'''
| Thanks.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Tell me a question!
| '''¡Dime una pregunta!'''
| I have one.
| '''Tengo una.'''
| Tell me!
| '''¡Dime!'''
| How do you write escribir?
| '''¿Cómo se escribe escribir?'''
| One writes e, s, c, r, i, b, i, r.
| '''Se escribe e, ese, ce, ere, i, be de burro, i, ere.'''
| Thanks.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Tell me a question!
| '''¡Dime una pregunta!'''
| I have one.
| '''Tengo una.'''
| Tell me!
| '''¡Dime!'''
| How do you write escribir?
| '''¿Cómo se escribe escribir?'''
| One writes e, s, c, r, i, b, i, r.
| '''Se escribe e, ese, ce, ere, i, be de burro, i, ere.'''
| Thanks.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>

| How do you write beige?

| The color? You write it with b as in Bob, e, i, g, e.
| '''¿El color? Se escribe con be de burro, e, i, ge, e.'''
| Thanks.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
